SingZ v0.19.1 post kit

Copy a caption, copy the image, paste both into the channel.

Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/v0.19.1-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ v0.19.1 — there's an iPhone app now

Your library plays on iPhone: the same lyrics, the same melody line, the same bar lines you fixed on the computer. Songs come over your own Google Drive, so what you split on the desktop is simply there when you pick up the phone. Downloaded songs keep playing with no signal.

It's an open beta while Apple looks over the listing — join here:
https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

On Mac, the app just opens now. Apple has checked this build, so the "Apple could not verify…" dialog and the trip into System Settings are both gone.

On Android, vocal training hears you — it measures your voice against itself instead of one fixed loudness, and the screen says what it can hear.

Android, Mac and Windows builds:
https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest

Russian

🎤 SingZ v0.19.1 — теперь есть приложение для iPhone

Ваша библиотека играет на iPhone: те же слова, та же линия мелодии, те же тактовые черты, что вы поправили на компьютере. Песни приходят через ваш собственный Google Drive — то, что вы разделили на десктопе, просто оказывается в телефоне. Скачанные песни играют и без связи.

Пока Apple смотрит витрину — открытая бета:
https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

На Mac приложение теперь просто открывается. Apple проверила эту сборку, так что окна «Apple не может проверить…» и похода в системные настройки больше нет.

На Android вокальный тренажёр вас слышит — громкость меряется относительно вашего же голоса, а экран говорит, что именно он слышит.

Сборки для Android, Mac и Windows:
https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/v0.19.1-poster.png
